args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

Per FIN-212, round_money should round half to even (banker's rounding).
Replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so that 2.675 rounds to
2.68 and 2.665 rounds to 2.66, matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py` so that:
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding)

## Testing

CI passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).
